events.title: Jigsaw Puzzle Competition and Puzzle Swap

cases.refreshed: Are you a dissectologist? Do you love the assembly of jigsaw puzzles? Join our adult puzzle competition! 10 teams of 4 people each, 2 hours, 500 pieces, and bragging rights. Each team receives the same 500-piece puzzle. No one gets to see the puzzle until the timer begins. The goal is to be the team that finishes the jigsaw puzzle in the shortest amount of time. If no team is finished at the 2-hour mark, the winning team will be the one with the fewest remaining loose pieces. Ages 14+; For puzzle swap, please bring puzzles with no missing pieces. Online Registration required, starting Sunday October 25 at 10 AM. Event capacity is 40 people. You may sign up in groups of four, or as individuals. This event is Sponsored by The Friends of the Cupertino Library. For accessibility accommodations (e.g., ASL), please fill out the online form at sccld.org/accessibility 7+ days prior to the event. If you need assistance with the form, speak with a staff member at your local library, call (408) 540-3945, or email us at ask@sccl.org.
